Boi canh: repo task-manager (D:\coding\personal-tools\task-manager), nhanh security-fixes-arch-review.
Council da THIET KE (run 7fd3e4d1, xem docs/exchanges/2026-09-12.md va commit 882bfde0) viec xoa han
actionType/aiNote/relatedIds tren tasks + release_task_definitions + emergency_release_task_definitions,
thay bang reply_to_definition_id (tro dung 1 definition khac), va Claude Code (khong phai Council) da tu
thuc thi toan bo thiet ke do (KHONG qua Council trong luc sua code). Implementation da xong, da commit
(commit 3571c21 tren nhanh security-fixes-arch-review), tsc --noEmit sach, 182 test server + 55 test
client deu xanh, npm run check dat 9/10 cong tu dong (cong con lai chi bao "exe chua repackage" da duoc
xu ly sau - da npm run package + restart exe that, tu kiem qua HTTP truc tiep: tao task, tao/sua/xoa
release definition co reply_to_definition_id, xac nhan backend tu choi 409 + rollback khi originRef gia/
khong ton tai, xac nhan backend bo qua gia tri replyToRef gia FE gui len va tu tinh lai tu definition
that).

DAY LA PHIEN REVIEW-CODE (khong phai thiet ke) - Council PHAI tu doc code that (khong doan, khong tin
bao cao tren) de xac nhan implementation co dung nhu thiet ke da chot khong, va tim moi loi/thieu sot
CON SOT.

YEU CAU CU THE:

1. Doc toan bo diff cua commit 3571c21 (hoac tuong duong: git show 3571c21, hoac doc truc tiep cac file
   da doi: server/schema/tasks.ts, server/schema/release.ts, server/db-migrations.ts, server/types.ts,
   server/lib/utils.ts, server/lib/mappers.ts, server/lib/release-render.ts, server/routes/tasks.ts,
   server/routes/release.ts, server/routes/schedules.ts, src/types.ts, src/screens/personal-task.tsx,
   src/screens/release.tsx, src/i18n.ts, src/styles.css, va toan bo file test da sua/xoa).

2. Xac nhan dung 4 nguyen tac thiet ke da chot o run 7fd3e4d1, KHONG duoc bo qua bat ky cai nao:
   a. Backend la nguon xac thuc DUY NHAT cho replyToRef khi tao task tu definition - KHONG duoc tin
      gia tri FE gui len cho truong nay o bat ky duong tao task nao (regular-bulk, regular-single,
      emergency).
   b. originRef khong resolve duoc = loi cung (409 + rollback toan bo transaction), AP DUNG DONG BO
      cho ca 3 duong tao task - khong duoc de 1 duong chat hon duong kia.
   c. Migration idempotent: them cot -> backfill tu related_ids cu -> archive JSON (kem checksum) ->
      drop cot trong 1 transaction. Archive phai xay ra TRUOC KHI drop, khong duoc mat du lieu.
   d. Xoa het UI/i18n con sot lien quan (AutomationFieldsEditor, badge "AI", cum UI "team" mention-hint
      da chet gan voi buoc AI precheck da xoa) - khong duoc de sot nhan/UI tro toi tinh nang da xoa.

3. Kiem tra rieng nhung diem co nguy co cao (Council tu quyet co can kiem gi khac ngoai danh sach nay
   khong, day chi la goi y bat dau, khong phai gioi han):
   - `server/routes/schedules.ts` duong regular-bulk tao task: co that su tra ve 409 + rollback DUNG
     TRANSACTION khi 1 originRef trong nhieu task khong resolve duoc, hay chi 1 phan bi loi con phan
     khac da commit?
   - `server/db-migrations.ts`: idempotent that khong (chay lai lan 2 tren DB da migrate xong co loi
     gi khong), thu tu goi ham co dung (them cot -> backfill -> archive+drop) khong bi dao nguoc.
   - Cac route DELETE definition co kiem tra "dang duoc definition khac tro toi lam reply_to_definition_id"
     truoc khi xoa khong (tranh de lai FK treo) - ca 2 bang release_task_definitions va
     emergency_release_task_definitions.
   - Frontend `src/screens/release.tsx`: dropdown reply-to moi co dung dung field/kieu du lieu khong,
     co con sot logic FE tu tinh replyToRef nao khong (phai xoa het, khong phai giu lam fallback).
   - Test da sua/them co that su kiem tra dung hanh vi MOI hay chi duoc sua cho xanh ma khong con kiem
     tra gi co y nghia (vd assertion bi xoa thay vi duoc thay bang assertion tuong duong voi hanh vi moi).

4. Neu tim thay van de THAT (co bang chung file:dong, khong phai suy doan), liet ke ro rang, kem muc do
   nghiem trong va cach sua cu the. Neu khong tim thay van de gi chan duoc, ky "khong phan doi" kem pham
   vi da soi (R-CRIT-01/03 - khong duoc bia phan doi cho co).

5. Day la PHIEN REVIEW - KHONG tu sua code. Ket qua la danh sach phat hien (co the rong) de Claude Code
   ap dung sau, roi bao cao lai nguoi dung.
